column1: # Per-demo floor for the vega style: the score each demo had in the B0 run (docs/baseline-2026-11-24.md),
# judged against shadcn-vue d1bf1b3a2d1a824b19f32d7253a28a43797b8253, light, the style's default theme and tolerance.
# run.sh (through compare.mjs) fails any run of those settings, full or a subset of pages, in which a demo scores
# below its row, and reports a demo that has no row. Scores are printed to one decimal, as in verdict.txt.
# Raising a row is part of the change that raised the score (like floor.tsv's line); lowering one is not allowed
# except by an ADR. A demo added upstream gets its row in the change that adds it.
# Open regression of wave C (to fix in M15): the six message-scroller rows at 51.9, 72.1, 77.7, 66.1, 58.3, 76.7
# were 52.1, 73.7, 79.7, 66.3, 65.4, 76.8 before; the rows rise when they are fixed.
